en: Stop at the junction and give way to vehicles with priority
Give way to the vehicles in front of you
Stop for the red traffic light

exp.en: The stop sign requires you to stop and give way.

en: Traffic is permitted only in these two directions
Turn to the right and to the left

en: Who has right of way in this picture?
